aiu_saveFirst: Save the settings first — the sign-in link will appear here.
aiu_waitingForLink: Waiting for the sign-in link from the instance …
aiu_step1: 1. Open the sign-in page and log in with your Claude account.
aiu_step2: 2. Copy the code shown on the last page and redeem it here.
aiu_signInDone: Signed in — usage data arrives with the next poll.
aiu_instanceNotRunning: The instance is not running — start it to sign in.
aiu_storedHint: Your centrally stored AI credentials plus the Claude subscription — switch on what to monitor. New keys are added under Settings → Credentials.
aiu_noCredentials: No AI credentials stored yet — add them in the admin settings under Credentials.
aiu_claudeCaption: Subscription — signs in with your Claude account instead of a key
